status: complete for second predeclared within-stratum visual test

external_annotation_source.provenance: plant_features table; visual feature annotations only. Text enrichment results from that repository were not used.

scope: 24 early Herbal page-sides visible in the externally sourced feature table and eligible for the frozen W20 residual; effectively a narrow Herbal-A / Currier-A / hand-1 domain
reproductive_structure_definition: berries, pods/fruits, or seeds explicitly present in the external visual feature list; combined before residual comparison as a broad reproductive-structure label
statistic: Euclidean distance between positive/negative page centroids in standardized frozen 2D residual; page residual is mean of eligible paragraph residual coordinates
null: exact permutation of page labels preserving positive count
interpretation: None of four independently defined visual plant-morphology labels is associated with the robust 2D residual under the frozen exact test. Together with the Biological visual pilot, current page-aggregated residual evidence does not support H58-1.
qualification: The test is page-level. Paragraph-specific semantics tied to particular illustrated subobjects could be averaged away. A spatial paragraph-to-object annotation is required to test that stronger/localized possibility without post-hoc matching.
